title: Static driver UNLOAD does not clear initialized state
description:
`indigo_server/indigo_server.c:1378-1386`: dynamic unload uses indigo_remove_driver, but static unload directly calls the entry point's SHUTDOWN and changes the visible DRIVERS switch without setting the registry entry's initialized=false. A subsequent DRIVERS enable at1275 requires `!driver->initialized` before calling INIT. Thus a statically linked driver unloaded through UNLOAD can appear re-enabled while its devices remain absent. The normal DRIVERS-disable branch already clears initialized after successful SHUTDOWN, so the alternate path is inconsistent. Remediation: clear static initialized only after successful shutdown, preserve it on Full evidence: C-06. Remediation: clear static initialized only after successful shutdown, preserve it on BUSY/failure, and regress UNLOAD followed by DRIVERS enable on a bounded stub static driver. No actual driver was unloaded during the audit.
